label: dragIsOneStep: the drag token not passed to setPath, so 120 handle moves are 120 undo steps
find: try t.setPath(path, name: title, drag: drag)
replace: try t.setPath(path, name: title, drag: nil)

label: closeNeedsThree: close allowed with two anchors
oneStepPerRun: setPath called per anchor in anchor-move, so moving three points records three steps
find: { t, p in try edit(&t, "Move Points", drag: p.drag) { AnchorEdit.moved($0.path, $1, dx: p.dx, dy: p.dy) } }
replace: { t, p in for ref in t.anchorSelection.ordered { _ = try edit(&t, "Move Points", drag: p.drag) { e, _ in AnchorEdit.moved(e.path, [ref], dx: p.dx, dy: p.dy) } }; return .object([:]) }

label: insertUnavailableOffThePath: the reach check dropped, so a click off the path adds a point
everyWhyNot: a handle drag on a point with no handle there runs without breaking
find: guard breaking || (p.end == .handleIn ? a.handleIn : a.handleOut) != nil else
replace: guard breaking || a.handleIn == nil || a.handleIn != nil else

label: drawRefusesFewerThanTwo: path.draw takes a single point
